```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  PPA_USER: jdx
  PPA_REPO: mise
  DEBEMAIL: ci@example.com
  DEBFULLNAME: CI Bot

jobs:
  publish-ppa:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install cargo-deb
        run: cargo install cargo-deb

      - name: Install dput and gnupg
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y dput gnupg

      - name: Import PPA GPG key
        env:
          PPA_KEY: ${{ secrets.PPA_KEY }}
          PPA_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.PPA_PASSPHRASE }}
        run: |
          echo "$PPA_KEY" | gpg --import --batch --yes
          gpg --list-keys

      - name: Create dput configuration
        run: |
          cat <<EOF > ~/.dput.cf
          [ppa]
          fqdn = uploads.ubuntu.com
          incoming = /incoming
          login = $PPA_USER
          EOF

      - name: Build .deb package
        run: cargo deb

      - name: Upload to PPA
        env:
          DEBEMAIL: ${{ env.DEBEMAIL }}
          DEBFULLNAME: ${{ env.DEBFULLNAME }}
        run: |
          dput ppa:$PPA_USER/$PPA_REPO ./target/debian/*.deb
```
